name: Receive fails (mint claims the ecash was already spent)
description: The wallet tries to redeem a 10-sat ecash token, but the mint wrongly replies that the money was already spent. The wallet treats this as final: nothing is credited, no stuck pending entry is left behind, and the balance is unchanged.
details: Fund 20 testnut sats (net 19), then paste a fresh cocod 10-sat token while POST /v1/swap answers 400 {11001 proofs already spent}: unlike a network failure this is TERMINAL — no pending receive is recorded, nothing is credited, and after the rule clears the balance is still exactly 19 (delta 0 from a fresh ₿0 wallet (the incoming token is the sole declared funding effect)). The unredeemed token stays with cocod (valueless testnut, auto-written-off). Documents the terminal-redeem failure surface. Fresh-wallet variant: testnut is an unknown mint, so the first redeem opens the trust review (proven legs from receive.cashu.unknown-mint); trust is granted against the live /v1/info (un-faulted) and the SECOND redeem hits the faulted swap
